parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2590599.html operation to query the IDs of rules
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2590599.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The action specified in the rule. Valid values:

1: alert

2: block
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作，取值：

1：告警。

2：拦截
parameters.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

1: enabled

0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则的开关状态。取值：

1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

1: system rule

2: custom rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
1: 系统规则
2: 用户规则
parameters.name: rule_type

fields.help_en:
The hash values of the files that need to be added to the whitelist.

This parameter is not supported
fields.name: hash

fields.help_en: The images that need to be added to the whitelist
fields.name: image

fields.help_en: The paths to the files that need to be added to the whitelist
fields.help_zh: 加入白名单的文件路径列表
fields.name: path

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

0: no

1: yes
fields.help_zh:
是否包含所有命名空间，取值：

0：否。
1：是
fields.name: all_namespace

fields.help_en:
The ID of the cluster on which the rule takes effect.

You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters
fields.help_zh:
指定要生效的集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
fields.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The effective scope of the rule
